tasks.short: Document divided remains and their locations

steps.what: Observe the actual divided remains and containers and capture each identifier, portion and physical location
Write the actual divided-remains tracking entry used by staff to locate each portion
Compare the working entry against the actual container identifiers and locations and resolve discrepancies
Save the ordinary tracking entry in the same case system

tasks.enabler_now: Native child-record fields can reuse the parent identifier without inventing actual location facts.
tasks.still_hard: The record must match each physical portion and container.
tasks.human_edge: The operator notices ambiguous labels, misplaced containers and inconsistent counts.

ambition.what: No automated release or change of custody.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: parent-child case fields can reduce repeated identifiers in portion tracking while physical identity checks remain human.

tasks.short: Explain cremation to family and friends

steps.what: Read the applicable facility process information and identify the family's actual question
Explain the actual cremation process sensitively and answer the family's or friends' questions
outputs: process explained to family or friends

tasks.previous_blocker: An uncommon process question can require navigation within the facility's information set.
tasks.enabler_now: Native section links can remove only the navigation component.
tasks.still_hard: Families differ in what they want to know and how much detail they can receive.
tasks.human_edge: The operator notices distress and adjusts the explanation with care.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: section bookmarks can shorten source retrieval while sensitive cremation explanations remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is the actual oral explanation, not obtaining consent, making arrangements or issuing instructions. No trailing contact report is added where nobody keeps or reads one.

tasks.short: Offer counsel and comfort to bereaved people

steps.what: Listen to the actual bereaved family or friends, offer appropriate comfort and respond to their expressed concerns
inputs: actual bereaved people's concerns and responses

tasks.design: Keep the actual counsel and comfort conversation with the operator. {OTHER} denotes the face-to-face care setting rather than a software assistant.
tasks.previous_blocker: No repeated information transformation is identified inside this care conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional tool removes the listening and response work in this boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Grief, silence and individual concerns cannot be reduced to a standard response.
tasks.human_edge: The operator provides presence and recognizes how the person is responding.

ambition.what: Preserve the actual personal support conversation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: offering personal comfort to bereaved people requires human listening and response; no repeat administrative action is inherent in the conversation.

assumptions: Boundary is actual personal counsel and comfort. No referral lookup, appointment, written advice, contact record or send is assumed to occur today in this episode.

steps.what: Retrieve the actual deceased person's documents and identify the applicable case and document versions
Read the actual identity documents and compare identifying details and document consistency
Compare the documents with the actual case and physical identification tags
Resolve actual identity discrepancies through the existing responsible staff route or retain the unresolved status
outputs: identity reading conclusion or unresolved discrepancy

tasks.design: Link the actual identity-document set to the existing case in {OTHER}, the crematory case system, and {DOCS}. The operator reads the documents, compares physical tags and resolves discrepancies; a retrieved match never authorizes cremation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual case documents can require a separate search across the document workspace.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case-document links can remove navigation while retaining document reading and physical identification.
tasks.still_hard: Similar names, conflicting documents and incorrect tags require actual resolution.
tasks.human_edge: The operator recognizes when apparent agreement is insufficient to establish identity.

ambition.what: No automated identity clearance or cremation authorization.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: case-document links can shorten retrieval but cannot replace physical and documentary identity checks.

assumptions: Boundary ends with document reading and the actual identity comparison conclusion, not a formal clearance, release or equipment-start command. Any actual formal authorization requires its real authority and separate gated action after the complete evidence exists.
